en.s: The Battle of Nineveh was the climactic battle of the Byzantine–Sasanian War of 602–628. In mid-September 627, Heraclius invaded Sasanian Mesopotamia in a surprising, risky winter campaign. Khosrow II appointed Rhahzadh as the commander of an army to confront him. Heraclius' Göktürk allies quickly deserted, while Rhahzadh's reinforcements did not arrive in time. In the ensuing battle, Rhahzadh was slain and the remaining Sasanian forces retreated.

zh.s: 627年12月12日，拜占庭—萨珊战争期间爆发尼尼微战役，这是该战争的决战。此前，希拉克略于627年9月中旬在冬季冒险突袭萨珊王朝的美索不达米亚地区。库思老二世派拉哈扎德率军迎战，希拉克略的突厥盟友很快撤离，而拉哈扎德的援军未能及时赶到。交战中，拉哈扎德阵亡，剩余的萨珊军队撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Roccavione was the last battle of the invasion of the territory of Asti by Angevine troops from the Kingdom of Sicily. Charles I of Sicily was defeated, and his entire invasion failed. The battle was also the end of the Astigiani participation in the wars of the Guelphs and Ghibellines, and the end of Charles' intervention in the rest of the Italian Peninsula.

zh.s: 罗卡维奥内战役于1275年12月12日爆发，是西西里王国安茹军队入侵阿斯蒂领地期间的最后一战。西西里的卡洛一世战败，入侵行动彻底失败。这场战役也标志着阿斯蒂人参与归尔甫派与吉伯林派战争的结束，以及卡洛一世干预意大利半岛事务的终结。

en.s: The Battle of Zlatitsa (Bulgarian: Битка при Златица) was fought on 12 December 1443 between the Ottoman Empire and Serbian Hungarian troops in the Balkans. The battle was fought at Zlatitsa Pass (Bulgarian: Златишки проход) (Turkish: Izladi Derbendi) near the town of Zlatitsa in the Balkan Mountains, Ottoman Empire (modern-day Bulgaria). The impatience of the king of Poland and the severity of the winter then compelled Hunyadi (February 1444) to return home, but not before he had utterly broken the Sultan's power in Bosnia, Herzegovina, Serbia, Bulgaria, and Albania.

zh.s: 兹拉蒂察战役于1443年12月12日在巴尔干半岛爆发，交战双方是奥斯曼帝国与塞尔维亚、匈牙利联军。战斗发生在巴尔干山脉的兹拉蒂察山口附近，当时该地属于奥斯曼帝国，如今位于保加利亚。后来，波兰国王的不耐烦以及严酷冬季迫使匈雅提于1444年2月返乡；在此之前，他已重创苏丹在波斯尼亚、黑塞哥维那、塞尔维亚、保加利亚和阿尔巴尼亚的势力。

en.s: The siege of Shimabara Castle (December 12, 1637 – January 8, 1638) was an unsuccessful siege of the Shimabara Castle by rebel peasants and ronin during Shimabara Rebellion. Although the castle garrison was too weak to defend the castle town, which was completely looted and burned down, the numerically superior rebels were not able to storm the heavily fortified citadel.

en.s: The action of 12 December 1782 was a naval engagement fought off the coast of Spain near Ferrol, in which the British 40-gun fifth rate HMS Mediator successfully attacked a convoy of five armed ships. The convoy was part of Pierre-Augustin de Beaumarchais' supply chain to the American colonists.

A British Bombay Army force landed at Tellicherry and with the aid of sepoys and horses provided by Travancore, defeated Tipu's commander, Hussain Ali Khan, at Calicut.

en.t: The U.S. military government outlaws the People’s Republic of Korea in the south

en.s: United Nations Security Council Resolution 13 was adopted unanimously on 12 December 1946. The Council recommended that the General Assembly admit Siam as a member state. Prince Wan Waithayakon became the first United Nations ambassador from the country.

en.s: The 1953 North Dunedin by-election was a by-election held during the 30th New Zealand Parliament in the Dunedin electorate of North Dunedin. The by-election occurred following the death of MP Robert Walls and was won by Ethel McMillan.

zh.s: 新西兰北达尼丁选区于1953年12月12日举行补选。这是新西兰第30届议会期间的一次补选，因议员罗伯特·沃尔斯去世而触发，埃塞尔·麦克米伦胜出。

en.s: The Battle of Spilia was fought on December 12, 1955 in the EOKA campaign against the British in Cyprus. Acting on information provided by an informant, 700 soldiers of the British Army attempted to encircle the headquarters of EOKA General Georgios Grivas on the Troodos mountains near the village of Spilia. As they ascended the mountain, EOKA guerrillas spotted them. Grivas divided his troops in two, keeping half with himself to fight the units coming from the north side while sending his second-in-command Grigoris Afxentiou to fight the rest of the British who were ascending on the south side.

zh.s: 1955年12月12日，塞浦路斯独立运动EOKA针对英国军队发动斯皮利亚战役。英国军方根据线人提供的情报，派出700名士兵试图包围EOKA领导人乔治·格里瓦斯在特罗多斯山区、斯皮利亚村附近的总部。英军上山时被EOKA游击队发现。格里瓦斯将部队分成两部分，自己率一半迎战从北面逼近的英军，另一半则由副手格里戈里斯·阿夫克森蒂乌率领，迎战从南面上山的英军。

en.s: The Border campaign (12 December 1956 – 26 February 1962) was a guerrilla warfare campaign (codenamed Operation Harvest) carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) against targets in Northern Ireland, with the aim of overthrowing British rule there and creating a united Ireland. It was also referred to as the "resistance campaign" by some Irish republican activists.

zh.s: 爱尔兰共和军于1956年12月12日至1962年2月26日在北爱尔兰发动边境行动，也称“丰收行动”。这是一场游击战，目标是推翻英国在北爱尔兰的统治、实现爱尔兰统一。部分爱尔兰共和主义者也称之为“抵抗运动”。

en.s: The Raid on Limbang (Malay: Serangan/Serbuan di Limbang) was a military engagement between British Royal Marine commandos and insurgents of the North Kalimantan National Army (Tentara Nasional Kalimantan Utara: TNKU), on 12 December 1962. After an amphibious assault on the town of Limbang in Sarawak, Borneo, the commandos managed to rescue the hostages being held there by the TNKU.

zh.s: 林梦突袭战于1962年12月12日爆发，交战双方是英国皇家海军陆战队突击队与北加里曼丹国民军（TNKU）武装人员。突击队两栖登陆婆罗洲砂拉越的林梦镇，成功救出了被TNKU扣押的人质。

en.s: The Piazza Fontana Bombing (Italian: Strage di Piazza Fontana) was a terrorist attack that occurred on 12 December 1969 when a bomb exploded at the headquarters of Banca Nazionale dell'Agricoltura (National Agrarian Bank) in Piazza Fontana (some 200 metres from the Duomo) in Milan, Italy, killing 17 people and wounding 88. The same afternoon, three more bombs were detonated in Rome and Milan, and another was found unexploded.

zh.s: 1969年12月12日，意大利米兰丰塔纳广场的意大利国家农业银行总部发生炸弹袭击，造成17人死亡、88人受伤。银行距离米兰大教堂约200米。同日下午，罗马和米兰又发生三起爆炸，另有一枚炸弹被发现但未爆炸。

en.s: Operation Cactus Lilly, better known as The Meghna Heli Bridge or the Crossing of the Meghna, was an air assault operation conducted between 9 and 12 December 1971 during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971. It was conducted by the Indian Army and Indian Air Force to cross the Meghna River, bypass a Pakistani stronghold at Ashuganj/Bhairab Bazar and reach Dhaka.

zh.s: 仙人掌百合行动也称“梅格纳河直升机桥”或“梅格纳河渡河行动”，是1971年印巴战争期间印度陆军和印度空军于12月9日至12日实施的一次空中突击行动。部队借此渡过梅格纳河，绕开阿舒甘杰／拜拉布巴扎尔的巴基斯坦据点，向达卡推进。

en.s: The Tangail Airdrop (11 December 1971) was an airborne operation conducted by the Indian Army in order to seize Poongli Bridge and ferry in the Tangail area. The operation, involving the 2nd Battalion of the Indian Army's Parachute Regiment (2 Para) is often regarded as one of the largest - if not the largest - airborne operation following World War II.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in North Korea on 12 December 1972. Only one candidate was presented in each constituency, all of which were selected by the Workers' Party of Korea, although some ran under the banner of other parties or state organisations to give an appearance of democracy. Voter turnout was reported to be 100%, with 100% voting in favour of the candidates presented. In the first session, between 25 and 28 December 1972, the SPA approved a new constitution, put into force a presidential system, with Kim Il-sung elected as president.

zh.s: 朝鲜于1972年12月12日举行议会选举。每个选区只有一名候选人，均由朝鲜劳动党选定；部分候选人虽以其他政党或组织名义参选，但只是为了营造民主选举的表象。官方称投票率和候选人赞成率均为100%。最高人民会议于12月25日至28日举行首次会议，通过新宪法、实行总统制，并选举金日成为国家主席。

en.s: General elections were held in Bahrain for the first time on 12 December 1973. 30 seats out of the 44-seated unicameral National Assembly were contested, the other 14 were ex officio. Of the 24,883 registered voters, 19,509 cast a ballot, giving a voter turnout of 78.4%. Two distinct political blocs amongst the elected members; the "People's Bloc" consisted of eight Shia and Sunni members elected from urban areas and associated with left-wing and nationalist organizations, including the Popular Front for the Liberation of Bahrain, the National Liberation Front – Bahrain or the Baathist movement.

zh.s: 巴林于1973年12月12日首次举行大选。44席的一院制国民议会中，30席通过选举产生，另外14席为当然席位。24883名登记选民中有19509人投票，投票率为78.4%。当选议员分属两个政治阵营。其中“人民阵线”由8名什叶派和逊尼派议员组成，他们在城市选区当选，与左翼和民族主义组织有关联，包括巴林人民解放阵线、巴林民族解放阵线和复兴党运动。

en.s: The Battle of Phước Long was a decisive battle of the Vietnam War which began on 12 December 1974, and concluded on 6 January 1975. The battle involved the deployment of the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) 4th Army Corps for the first time, against units of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) in Phước Long in Bình Phước Province near the Cambodian border (to be distinguished from the other Phước Long in Bạc Liêu Province, south of Saigon), under the command of Lieutenant General Dư Quốc Đống.

zh.s: 福隆战役是越南战争中的一场关键战役，始于1974年12月12日，至1975年1月6日结束。越南人民军第四军团首次投入战斗，与越南共和国军部队交战。战场位于福隆（Phước Long，今平福省），靠近柬埔寨边境；这座城市与西贡以南薄寮省的另一个福隆不是同一地点。越南共和国军部队由中将Dư Quốc Đống指挥。

en.s: The Balcombe Street siege involved members of the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) and London's Metropolitan Police, and lasted from 6 to 12 December 1975. The siege ended with the surrender of the four IRA members and the release of their two hostages. The events were televised and watched by millions.

en.s: Local elections were held in Portugal on Sunday, 12 December 1976. They were the first local elections in Portugal after the 1976 Constitution introduced the concept of democratic local power, that should be exerted by citizens in their towns and cities. These elections ended a cycle of three elections in 1976, after the legislative election in April and the Presidential election in June.

en.s: General elections were held in Zambia on 12 December 1978. At the time, the country was a one-party state, and as such, the United National Independence Party was the sole contestant in the elections. Its candidate Kenneth Kaunda was re-elected as President with 80.7% of the vote, whilst UNIP won all 125 seats in the National Assembly. Voter turnout was around 65% in the parliamentary election, but 66.7% in the presidential election.

zh.s: 赞比亚于1978年12月12日举行大选。当时该国实行一党制，联合民族独立党是唯一参选政党。该党候选人肯尼思·卡翁达以80.7%的选票连任总统，联合民族独立党赢得国民议会全部125席。议会选举投票率约为65%，总统选举投票率为66.7%。

en.s: The Coup d'état of December Twelfth (Hangul: 12.12 군사반란; Hanja: 12.12 軍事叛亂) or the "12.12 Military Insurrection" was a military coup d'état which took place on December 12, 1979, in South Korea. Republic of Korea Army Major General Chun Doo-hwan, commander of the Security Command, acting without authorization from Acting President Choi Kyu-ha, ordered the arrest of General Jeong Seung-hwa, ROK Army Chief of Staff, on allegations of involvement in the assassination of President Park Chung Hee. After Jeong's capture, 29th Regiment of the 9th Division, along with the 1st and 3rd Airborne Brigades, invaded downtown Seoul to support the 30th and 33rd Capital Security Group loyal to Chun, then a series of conflicts broke out in the capital.

zh.s: 1979年12月12日，韩国发生军事政变，又称“12·12军事叛乱”。保安司令官全斗焕少将未经代总统崔圭夏授权，下令逮捕陆军参谋总长郑昇和，指控他参与朴正熙总统遇刺案。郑昇和被捕后，第九师团第二十九团以及第一、第三空降旅开进首尔市中心，支援效忠全斗焕的首都警备司第三十、第三十三大队，随后首尔爆发一系列冲突。

en.s: An earthquake occurred at 02:59 local time on 12 December 1979, with the epicenter just offshore from the border between Ecuador and Colombia, near the port city of Tumaco. With a moment magnitude of 8.2 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent), it triggered a major tsunami, which was responsible for most of the estimated 300–600 deaths. The hardest hit area was Colombia's Nariño Department.

zh.s: 1979年12月12日当地时间凌晨2时59分，厄瓜多尔与哥伦比亚边境外海、港口城市图马科附近发生地震。地震矩震级为8.2级，麦加利地震烈度最高达IX级（猛烈），并引发大海啸。估计有300至600人死亡，其中多数死于海啸；受灾最严重的是哥伦比亚纳里尼奥省。

en.s: General elections were held in Malta on 12 December 1981. For the 1981 elections, the opposition Nationalist Party, reinvigorated with a new leader, looked set for a serious challenge to Mintoff. In fact, in that election, the Partit Nazzjonalista managed an absolute majority of votes, but it managed only 31 seats to the Labour Party's 34. Dom Mintoff said that he would not be ready to govern in such conditions and hinted that he would call for fresh elections within six months.

en.s: The 1982 Intercontinental Cup was a football match played on 12 December 1982 between Peñarol, winners of the 1982 Copa Libertadores, and Aston Villa, winners of the 1981–82 European Cup. The match was played at the National Stadium in Tokyo. It was Aston Villa's first appearance into the competition, whereas it was Peñarol's fourth appearance after the victories in 1961 and 1966, and the defeat in 1960.

zh.s: 1982年丰田杯于1982年12月12日在东京国家体育场举行，由1982年南美解放者杯冠军佩纳罗尔对阵1981–82赛季欧洲冠军杯冠军阿斯顿维拉。这是阿斯顿维拉首次参赛，佩纳罗尔则是第四次参赛；此前曾在1961年和1966年夺冠，并在1960年落败。

en.s: Local elections were held in Portugal on 12 December 1982. They were the third local elections in Portugal since the 1976 Constitution introduced the concept of democratic local power. The elections consisted of three separate elections in the 305 Portuguese municipalities that existed at the time, the election for the Municipal Chambers, another election for the Municipal Assembly and a last one for the lower-level Parish Assembly, whose winner is elected parish president, this last was held separately in the more than 4,000 parishes around the country.

en.s: Arrow Air Flight 1285R was an international charter flight carrying U.S. Army personnel from Cairo, Egypt, to their home base in Fort Campbell, Kentucky, US, via Cologne, West Germany, and Gander, Newfoundland. On the morning of Thursday, 12 December 1985, shortly after takeoff from Canada's Gander International Airport en route to Fort Campbell, the Douglas DC-8 serving the flight stalled, crashed, and burned about half a mile from the runway, killing all 248 passengers and 8 crew members on board.

zh.s: 箭航1285R号班机是一趟国际包机，载有美国陆军人员，从埃及开罗出发，经西德科隆和纽芬兰甘德，飞往他们位于美国肯塔基州坎贝尔堡的驻地。1985年12月12日星期四上午，飞机从加拿大甘德国际机场起飞前往坎贝尔堡后不久，执飞的道格拉斯DC-8失速，在距跑道约半英里处坠毁并起火，机上248名乘客和8名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The Clapham Junction rail crash was a multiple train collision just south of Clapham Junction railway station in London that occurred at about 08:10 on 12 December 1988. A crowded passenger train crashed into the rear of another train that had stopped at a signal, and subsequently sideswiped an empty train travelling in the other direction. 35 people died and 415 were injured. The collision was caused by a signal failure due to a wiring fault. New wiring had been installed, but the old wiring had been left connected at one end, and loose and uninsulated at the other.

zh.t: 克拉珀姆枢纽铁路事故
zh.s: 1988年12月12日上午约8时10分，伦敦克拉珀姆枢纽站南侧发生多列火车相撞事故。一列载客列车撞上在信号灯前停下的另一列火车，随后又擦撞一列从对向驶来的空车。事故造成35人死亡、415人受伤。事故由信号故障引起，原因是接线错误：新线路装好后，旧线路仍有一端接通，另一端则松脱且未做绝缘处理。

en.s: On 12 December 1993, a unit of the Provisional Irish Republican Army's (IRA) East Tyrone Brigade ambushed a two-men unmarked mobile patrol of the RUC in Fivemiletown, County Tyrone. Two constables (Andrew Beacom and Ernest Smith) were shot and killed instantly. A military helicopter was also fired at by a second IRA unit in the aftermath of the incident, during a follow-up operation launched in the surroundings of the town by both the British Army and the RUC.

en.s: On December 12, 2007, all seven members of the Federal Council, the government of Switzerland, were elected by the joint chambers of the Federal Assembly for the 2008–2012 term of office. en.s: Elections were held in Saudi Arabia on 12 December 2015 for municipal councils, which have limited decision-making powers on local issues such as rubbish collection and street maintenance. en.s: On December 12, 2023, jihadist militants from Katiba Macina, an affiliate of the al-Qaeda aligned Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM), attacked Malian forces in the town of Farabougou. The attack killed dozens of Malian soldiers and was the first major raid in the town by JNIM since the Siege of Farabougou in 2020.

zh.s: 2023年12月12日，马西纳旅的圣战武装分子袭击马里法拉布古镇的马里政府军。马西纳旅隶属于与基地组织关系密切的伊斯兰与穆斯林支持组织（JNIM）。袭击造成数十名马里士兵死亡，也是JNIM自2020年法拉布古围城战以来首次在该镇发动大规模袭击。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Egypt in December 2023, as announced by the National Election Authority, after speculation that the elections might be held earlier than expected. Candidate registration was from 5–14 October 2023 and the election was held in Egypt from 10 to 12 December; expatriates voted from 1–3 December.

en.s: The 29th Kolkata International Film Festival began on 5 December 2023 at Netaji Indoor Stadium, in Kolkata, India and ended on 12 December 2023. A 1963 romantic comedy Bengali film Deya Neya by Sunil Bannerjee opened the festival, which screened 219 films from 39 countries. Spain and Australia were country of focus in this edition of the festival.

en.s: The World Chess Championship 2024 was a chess match between the reigning world champion Ding Liren and the challenger Gukesh Dommaraju to determine the World Chess Champion. The match took place between 25 November and 12 December 2024 in Singapore. It was played to a best of 14 games, with tiebreaks if required. The match was won by Gukesh 7½–6½ after 14 games.

zh.s: 2024年世界国际象棋锦标赛于11月25日至12月12日在新加坡举行，由卫冕冠军丁立人对阵挑战者古克什·多马拉朱，争夺世界冠军。比赛采用最多14局制，若有需要则加赛快棋。双方在14局后战成7.5比6.5，古克什获胜。
